title: Change name or contact details on an industry participant and promoter registration
summary: You can change your contact details or name on your industry participant and promoter registration online.
intro:
You can change the contact details on your industry participant and promoter registration (address, email, mobile or telephone number) online. We will use these details to get in touch about your registration.

To change your name, complete the Combat Sports Authority Change of name form.

If you're also registered as a combatant, you'll also need to update your contact details on your combatant registration, go to Change name or contact details on a combatant registration.

### Changes to your MyServiceNSW Account.

Any changes you make to the contact details on your industry participant and promoter registration will not automatically update on your MyServiceNSW Account.

You should continue using your MyServiceNSW Account email address to access the Combat Sports Registration System. If you need to update your MyServiceNSW Account email address, go to Manage your details with your MyServiceNSW Account.
who_can_apply: Must be registered as an industry participant and promoter.
what_you_need: The Combat Sports Authority Change of name form
One form of identity document that contains a photo and has been issued in your new name
A copy of one of the following change of name documents (if changing name)
If only changing contact details, you need to follow the online steps.

how_to_steps.text: Log in to your MyServiceNSW Account.
Follow the prompts to change your contact details.
Gather the required information and documents.
Complete the Combat Sports Authority Change of name form.

faqs.q: What happens if I change my contact details on my industry participant and promoter registration?
faqs.a: The changes will not automatically update on your MyServiceNSW Account. You should continue using your MyServiceNSW Account email address to access the Combat Sports Registration System.

faqs.q: What do I do if I am also registered as a combatant?
faqs.a: You must also update your contact details on your combatant registration by going to [Change name or contact details on a combatant registration](https://www.service.nsw.gov.au/transaction/change-contact-details-combat-sports-combatant).

faqs.q: How do I change my name?
faqs.a: To change your name, you must complete the Combat Sports Authority Change of name form.
